issues.title: Ingest Jefferson County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $39,595,853 across 39 funds. The largest: General Fund ($12,900,016), Adult Jail ($6,118,608), Road Department ($5,948,298). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
